rules.name: verify-xoga750-fix2-gpc-trade-id-counter-dev
rules.sql: SELECT s.sequence_criteria ->> 'businessUnit' AS business_unit, s.last_sequence_id, s.start_value, s.end_value, s.sequence_type, s.parent_uuid, s.sequence_criteria::text AS sequence_criteria_json, (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.oga_configservice_transactionidformatmaster f WHERE f.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND f.uuid::text = s.parent_uuid AND f.transaction_type = 'tradeId') AS parent_is_tradeid_format FROM opera.oga_transaction_id_sequence_criteria s WHERE s.tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113' AND s.sequence_criteria ->> 'businessUnit' ILIKE 'gpc'

SELECT f.uuid, f.name, f.transaction_type, f.reference_format, f.number_of_digits, f.reset_value, f.transaction_sequence_criteria::text AS criteria_json, f.created_timestamp FROM opera.oga_configservice_transactionidformatmaster f WHERE f.tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113' AND f.created_by = 'xoga750-gpc'

SELECT f.uuid, f.created_by, f.created_timestamp FROM opera.oga_configservice_transactionidformatmaster f WHERE f.tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113' AND f.transaction_type = 'tradeId' ORDER BY f.created_timestamp DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT s.sequence_criteria ->> 'businessUnit' AS business_unit, s.last_sequence_id, s.updated_by, s.updated_timestamp FROM opera.oga_transaction_id_sequence_criteria s WHERE s.tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113' AND s.sequence_criteria ->> 'businessUnit' NOT ILIKE 'gpc' ORDER BY 1

expect.reason: reserveTradeIds needs exactly one sequence row for gpc
the next id is 54984, the first id old Opera gave
the parent is a tradeId format row, as for the other business units
the added GPC format row must not become the newest one (the service takes the newest format row for its digit count)
